recap: Welcome to the Open Era, family! Twenty-one castaways dropped on one beach with no direction, no map, no instructions — Aaliyah said her mouth was open for eighty percent of it, and honestly, same. They split into two tribes, Exile Island came roaring back, and I announced the return of the coin flip, where if it doesn't land, the money keeps climbing. Two million dollars on the table. Then we went to the first immunity challenge, and Savu took it — immunity and reward — while Toka trudged back to camp with a vote to make. Jenna was squarely in the crosshairs after struggling to open up, so she did what you do out here: she made a move. She took a small comment Aaliyah made about Brady being aggressive in the challenge and handed it right to Brady. He made it his mission. At Tribal, Patt said Aaliyah's name out loud, the Tribal went live, Jelly and Devin fought hard for her — and Aaliyah's torch got snuffed.
bullets: Savu swept the night: immunity AND reward, while Toka had to go to Tribal.
Jenna was on the block and flipped the target with one repeated comment — that's how you survive Day 3.
Brady heard he'd been called aggressive and made getting Aaliyah out his personal mission.
Patt saying Aaliyah's name out loud cracked Tribal wide open and turned it live.
Jelly and Devin fought for Aaliyah to the very end — it just wasn't enough.
draftImpact: Tami, Taylor, Tim, Austin — you all banked +4 and go from 0 to 4 with every single castaway still breathing. Tami, all five of yours survived night one. Kylie, tough break: Aaliyah Puglia was the first torch snuffed, so you take +3, sitting at 3 with 3 of your 4 still in. That puts Austin, Tami, Taylor and Tim tied at the top with 4 apiece, and Kylie one step behind. It's Episode 1, family — there's a lot of game left.
